project.title: 8 bit art — Pixel Art Stickers & Studio for iMessage
project.description:
Recovered and modernized my original 2018 iMessage sticker app for iPhone and iPad. The free collection includes 67 pixel-art stickers, search, and favorites. An optional permanent Studio Unlock adds a native 16×16 editor inside Messages, remix templates, and saved drafts. The project brings together native iOS development, editable pixel-art sources, and a reproducible asset pipeline, with artwork and source preserved together in GitHub.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1366485724

post.text:
Little pixels. Big feelings. 👾

I’ve brought 8 bit art back to life!

What started as my iMessage sticker project in 2018 now has 67 pixel-art stickers: cute animals, funny reactions, meme-inspired characters, and a few very necessary 67s.

The included collection is free, with search and favorites to keep your reactions close. Want to make your own? The optional, one-time Studio Unlock adds a 16×16 pixel editor, remix templates, and saved drafts—right inside Messages.

I’ve also recovered and modernized the project, with the artwork and source now preserved together in GitHub.

Download for iPhone and iPad:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id1366485724

After installing, open a conversation in Messages, tap +, and choose 8 bit art.

Which reaction should I add next?

#PixelArt #IndieDev #iOS
